M1 tests

Pair your M1 and close other printer apps before scanning. Each confirmed test sends one label, then queries the model and keeps the connection for your next click. Stop, leaving this screen or 60 seconds idle disconnects it. Stay here without rescanning to test consecutive prints. Check actual paper output.
